opening.argument: The video directly promotes BitConnect and HashFlare as ways to obtain recurring returns. BitConnect is called the speaker’s “biggest moneymaker and most consistent moneymaker,” while the speaker displays an active investment of $2,650 and says, “you can see they pay me.” HashFlare is likewise presented through purchased mining power tied to a share of pool output and claimed daily earnings. Viewers are invited to join the speaker’s team, and the presentation links investment or capacity purchases with payments and projected income. Although the speaker concedes that BitConnect “may be a ponzi scheme,” and the HashFlare calculation has limitations from maintenance fees, those qualifications do not undo the direct promotional framing of investment returns.
